entry.title: Games 4 Change Festival en (translated)
entry.summary: This entry points to the “Games 4 Change Festival”; it can first be placed in a games-industry events index as a starting point for further searching. The information here extends only to the event name and does not cover the date, location, agenda, or ways to participate; for now, readers can identify the event first and then decide whether to continue looking.

entry.title: PAX West Game Expo en (translated)
entry.summary: This entry points to PAX West. For now, it can be treated as an index entry for a game expo, allowing readers to identify the event and retain a starting point for further lookup. This paragraph deals only with the expo's name; it does not extend to the event's content, location, schedule, or participation arrangements. Planning a player's involvement would require checking those concrete conditions separately.

entry.title: gamescom Game Show (translated)
entry.summary: In 2027, gamescom will take place in Cologne, Germany, from August 23 to 29, while offering both in-person and digital ways to participate. The event centers on the global player community and the entire computer and video game industry, drawing hundreds of thousands of fans every year while also bringing together developers, publishers, esports professionals, cosplayers, and content creators. People from political and business circles take part as well, making gamescom not only a game show for fans but also an international forum where the industry, political sphere, and business community can connect with one another. As a result, the scale of gamescom is reflected not only in the number of attendees, but also in the way it places game content, player communities, and exchanges among political and business circles within the same event framework.

entry.title: [TGS 26] Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 TGS Hands-On Gameplay Video Released — Travel to a New World of the Future and Become the Hero You Want to Be! (translated)
entry.summary: Scheduled for release in 2027, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 offered a playable demo at TGS 2026, allowing players to experience the action game's actual feel before its official release. Bandai Namco brought the title to the show floor, with planned platforms including PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam; for players familiar with this manga IP, the presentation also moved the anticipated new game from promotional information into a stage where they could play it themselves, allowing them to first confirm whether they liked its gameplay direction and factor the demo and subsequent reviews into their expectations for the new title. The hands-on session at the show therefore became a concrete starting point for players to organize their expectations.

entry.title: The Apothecary Diaries ~The True and False Imperial Brother~ at TGS: An Original Mystery Adventure Unfolds from Mysteries and Curses (translated)
entry.summary: A mystery adventure game adapted from a popular novel is available to play at TGS, giving players an initial look at how it turns mysteries and curses into a journey they can actively navigate. Developed through a collaboration between GUST and TOHO Games, the exhibit brings the familiarity of the original work into a new way to play, while also letting players use the actual interaction to judge whether the adaptation works rather than merely recognize familiar characters and names. For those expecting the story and characters to be faithfully recreated, this demo first puts the focus on whether the interaction can sustain the original's sense of mystery. It also shifts the basis for judging the adaptation from its names to the actual play.

entry.title: Fate/EXTRA Record Reborn as a Modern RPG with an All-New System: TGS 2026 Media Briefing Reveals Details (translated)
entry.summary: Fate/EXTRA Record is scheduled for release in January 2027, with information on the new RPG's systems and playable demo first revealed at a TGS media briefing. The Aniplex booth put this remake's direction in front of players, allowing those familiar with the original to compare it with their memories before the official release, while giving those still watching from the sidelines a first look at the path the new version wants to take through its controls and showcased content. The focus of this information is not only the visual update, but how the new version rearranges the player's experience; actual play and later reviews will also shape players' final judgment.

entry.title: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival Is Now Available (translated)
entry.summary: With its retro pixel-art style and arcade-style combat, The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival turns the AMC series’ All-Out War storyline into a digital single-player game that has launched on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2. Players can choose Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, Michonne, or Negan, advance through 12 chapters across familiar locations such as Sanctuary, Hilltop, and Alexandria, and face hordes of Walkers and members of the Saviors; melee combos, ranged attacks, finishing moves, and multiple difficulty levels place the characters’ nostalgia within a combat framework built for repeated play.

entry.title: Sea of Thieves Season 21 Begins (translated)
entry.summary: Sea of Thieves Season 21 opened on September 17, bringing limited-time events and system improvements for Custom Seas into the same season: events such as Fight Nights and Emissaries of Fortune continue to appear, while the new Layouts can save objects and their positions in a custom world, allowing players to load an existing setup directly later. The first Talk Like a Pirate Day runs from September 17 to 22; successfully communicating with other crew members three times using the Parley Pennant earns the Parley Proficiency Sails. From September 17 to 21, there is also a Free Play Weekend that does not require an Xbox Game Pass or PlayStation Plus online subscription. Season 21 content is available free to players on all editions.

entry.title: Urban Myth Dissolution Center Free Thai Mod Released (translated)
entry.summary: The fan page “นักรบพเนจร” has created a free Thai mod for the visual novel, psychological horror, and mystery-adventure game “Urban Myth Dissolution Center,” giving players another language through which to enter Azami Fukurai’s story of investigating curses, cursed objects, and urban legends. This is not an official Thai version: the creator used AI-assisted translation and then checked and revised it; the mod may still contain translation or display problems and will need adjustment as the game is updated, so while players gain a free way into the language, they also have to judge for themselves whether the unofficial files suit their installation environment.

entry.title: OVER RUSH Mobile Card RPG Open Beta Underway (translated)
entry.summary: OVER RUSH has launched a one-week limited open beta in Japan. From September 17 to 24, players can try this mobile RPG built around high-speed card battles on Android and iOS. The test is short, so players can use the hands-on experience to judge the pace of combat before deciding whether to keep following its future development.

entry.title: Atelier of Kalia: Learning from the Past of Synthesis, Then Adding New Charm (translated)
entry.summary: Atelier of Kalia is scheduled for release in February 2027. At TGS 2026, GUST producer Junzo Hosoi and director Daiki Fukui explained that the game stars Kalia, who has lost her memories and joined an expedition team. The setting remains Aradis, following Atelier Yumia, and the story will delve into an unknown underground world. The new game places “learning after eating an item” at the center of its systems: eating changes not only Kalia’s appearance, but also her abilities and body shape, with those changes linked to synthesis. The game also draws on the synthesis ideas of the earlier titles, while adding cooking, styles that can affect exploration, and a battle system in which most physical and magical attacks can be answered with parries. This makes both the series’ familiar identity and its new systems key points to watch. The game will not support previous-generation consoles, and the team has also adjusted the controls and optimization for Switch 2 and PC.

entry.title: Mitsukiyo on Paréidolia: The Musical Core Where Comfort and Mystery Coexist (translated)
entry.summary: At TGS 2026, Nexon Games' IO division officially unveiled Paréidolia, previously known as Project RX, and disclosed actual gameplay content and the project's key terms. Music director Mitsukiyo said that roughly 80 percent of the new work's sonic direction differs from Blue Archive, using lo-fi and house as its foundation while placing comfort, retro sensibilities, and mystery in settings where everyday life and another world coexist; the team also added more live-instrument performances so the music could more readily evoke images of old houses, the countryside, and dusk. The unveiling therefore did more than fill in the game's name: it established a recognizable identity through both gameplay and atmosphere, allowing the previously scattered Project RX information to begin converging into a concrete work. That gives the anticipation something tangible to attach to.

entry.title: What Persona 4 Revival Keeps—and What It Changes (translated)
entry.summary: Atlus will rebuild the 2008 game Persona 4 as the full remake Persona 4 Revival, while retaining the warm everyday life of the town of Inaba, its changing weather, and the central mystery plot. Producer Kazuhisa Wada and director Daisuke Yajima said the new version turns Inaba into a fully 3D space with a freely rotatable camera, reworking the UI, battles, events, and overall systems while also adjusting dungeon exploration, schedule management, and Social Link difficulty, so returning players can see how the presentation has changed and new players can get into it more easily. Dungeons still retain the basic direction of progressing floor by floor, while quality-of-life features are used to reduce unnecessary exploration pressure; the PS5, Xbox, and PC versions are scheduled for release on February 18, 2027, followed by the Nintendo Switch 2 version on May 20.

entry.title: 【TGS 26】Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance Hands-On Demo — Challenging a High-Difficulty Teostra and the New Monster “Penchong Bird” (translated)
entry.summary: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance is scheduled for release in 2027, but TGS 2026 is offering an early PS5 hands-on demo that lets players take on a high-difficulty Teostra hunt and encounter the new monster “Penchong Bird.” The experience turns the much-anticipated, large-scale expansion into an interactive combat showcase ahead of its release.

entry.title: [TGS 26] Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX Development Team Discusses the Impetus Behind Development, Hoping Players Can Enjoy Yu-Gi-Oh! Again (translated)
entry.summary: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX is scheduled for release on February 16, 2027, with TGS 2026 giving players an early chance to try it; in the interview, the team also discussed its direction for recapturing the fun of the series. The game is planned for PC and Nintendo Switch 1|2, while the on-site information also laid out the release date, platforms, and design philosophy.

entry.title: Featuring Full-Figured Girl Characters and Strategic Battles That Manipulate Time: Hands-On with MIRESI: The Invisible Future【TGS 2026】 (translated)
entry.summary: In the same demo, MIRESI: The Invisible Future places time-manipulation strategy battles alongside segments where players can interact with characters in the “Council Room”; after trying it at Smilegate’s booth, 4Gamer focuses on the contrast between the two types of gameplay, as well as the tension between the battle system and the appeal of its characters.

entry.title: Gachiakuta BREAKOUT Uses Evasion and Counterattacks to Build Nonstop Offense and Defense: The Development Team on Recreating the Anime and the Survival System (PR) (translated)
entry.summary: Gachiakuta BREAKOUT turns the discarded materials from the original work into weapons, with its combat centered on how evasion and counterattacks can be chained into a continuous exchange of offense and defense. 4Gamer interviewed the Com2uS Japan development team, focusing on how the game recreates the experience of the original work while adding survival elements.

entry.title: The "BA Successor" 3D Anime-Style Game FAREIDOLIA Debuts; NEXON Producer Says Its Competitors Are All Cross-Platform Anime-Style Games (translated)
entry.summary: When FAREIDOLIA made its debut, its market positioning was aimed squarely at cross-platform anime-style games; GameLook placed the 3D title in the context of intensifying competition in this year's global anime-style game market, and quoted a NEXON producer discussing the title. The focus here is how the new title's arrival fits into the competitive landscape.

entry.title: Another Sony Tragedy? 《Marathon》 Has Only Around 2,000 Players Online; Seasonal Model Cancelled, PvE Pushed to Year-End (translated)
entry.summary: GameLook reports that after Marathon's peak concurrent player count fell from 88,000 to around 2,000, Bungie has rearranged the update cadence for the live-service shooter: it is cancelling the seasonal model and pushing PvE content back to the end of the year. The change in the size of the player base is therefore directly tied to adjustments to the schedule for subsequent content and operations.

entry.title: Wardogs CEO sparks controversy after saying he would not hire people unwilling to work overtime, responds that the company once adopted a four-day workweek (translated)
entry.summary: The game sold 2 million copies in five days and generated more than $80 million in revenue, yet its striking performance was overshadowed by the CEO’s comments on working hours. After he drew backlash by saying he would not hire people unwilling to work overtime, he responded by pointing out that the company had previously adopted a four-day workweek, shifting the controversy from sales performance to a discussion of work arrangements and overtime culture.

entry.title: Valve Confirms Steam Deck 2 Development Remains on Schedule (translated)
entry.summary: Valve is still developing the Steam Deck 2 at its planned pace; the key is not simply updating the spec sheet, but whether the next generation’s performance can give players a tangible generational leap. In an interview with IGN, developers Pierre-Loup Griffais and Jeff Leinbaugh said that rising RAM costs have not had much impact on the plan so far, and that the company is still watching the market and available technology; hardware pricing, however, will be another hurdle. The standard configurations of both the Steam Machine and Steam Frame cost more than $1,000, and the Steam Machine is also above Valve’s original target, meaning the Steam Deck 2 must find both a sufficiently large performance jump and a price affordable for most players if it is to continue the appeal the original established through its price advantage.

entry.title: GTA 6 Online mode is expected to launch next year (translated)
entry.summary: The single-player story of GTA 6 is expected to launch this November, but according to a judgment from Twitch CEO Dan Clancy cited by Bloomberg, the platform’s viewership may see its real, larger breakout only after the multiplayer mode arrives next year. That makes GTA 6 Online a second-wave engine, arriving after the main game and tasked with extending its momentum, while also echoing the path GTA 5 took by relying on GTA Online to sustain its life cycle over the long term. As for the release arrangement, some observers speculate that Online could launch alongside the PC version; recent reports that the PC port may arrive earlier than Rockstar’s usual pattern have become the basis for that speculation.

entry.title: The Resident Evil Film Scores 97% on Rotten Tomatoes, the Highest in Video Game Adaptation History (translated)
entry.summary: Zach Cregger’s new Resident Evil film has opened with a 97% critics’ score on Rotten Tomatoes from US press screenings, surpassing Sonic the Hedgehog 3’s 86% and temporarily ranking as the highest-rated video game adaptation. The result extends the director’s track record of strong reception, with Companion, Weapons, and Barbarian all scoring above 90%, but it also sharpens the divide over the adaptation’s direction: the trailer has already drawn backlash from some game fans because the film does not use characters from the games, instead setting its new story in a modern world parallel to the second and third games. The film will be released in the US on September 18 and in Thailand on September 24.

entry.title: Nivalis Night Surpasses 1 Million Steam Wishlists (translated)
entry.summary: Nivalis Night has surpassed 1 million wishlists on Steam, drawing considerable attention before launch for this game that combines a cyberpunk city with life simulation. Developed by the team behind Cloudpunk and set in Nivalis, it lets players explore neon districts on foot or by boat, run a ramen bar, tavern, restaurant, and club, as well as grow crops, fish, decorate their homes, and develop relationships with residents as regular customers, friends, or romantic partners. The PC version is scheduled to launch on Steam on the 30th; this wishlist result far exceeds Cloudpunk's record of around 130,000, and Ion Lands creative director Marco Dieckmann said the team was both surprised and grateful to reach one million.

entry.title: Last Origin and Maison de Queen Collaborate to Produce an OST (translated)
entry.summary: Vallofe announced on the 18th that it is producing a collaborative OST for Last Origin with the Japanese six-member female idol group Maison de Queen, with the VIA music production team, which previously handled the game’s first album, in charge. This collaboration extends the game’s existing music into new songs and live performances: the song is scheduled to be unveiled for the first time at “Illustar Fes,” held at KINTEX in Ilsan on October 10. On October 11, Maison de Queen will also perform the daytime show “Maison de Queen with 4 Korean idol” at Sinchon’s Illustar Stage, as well as its first solo concert in Korea, “Maison de Queen ONE-MAN LIVE.” For Vallofe, this is also an arrangement that lets fans encounter the IP through music, performances, and other means.

entry.title: MapleStory M Union System Overhaul Lets Players Allocate Ability Points Directly (translated)
entry.summary: The Union overhaul in MapleStory M gives players more control over progression decisions: ability values are no longer earned by filling tiles on the battle map, but by directly allocating points; characters level 200 and above can also freely change jobs, with the system providing loaner equipment suited to the new class based on the level of their existing gear. Nexon is also adding a “Combat Power Guide” that shows which Bosses players can challenge and how they can improve based on their combat power, while expanding the default inventory and storage slots and introducing convenience features such as permanently unlocking the pocket slot and removing Buff Freezer. Limited-time content will follow the update as well: “Super Week” runs from September 24 to October 5, a 10th Anniversary Shop and countdown login event begin on October 1, and from that day through November 11, “Lady Blair's Dream Express” allows players to transfer cosmetic outfits, pets, and mount items within a world.

entry.title: Physint confirms Bill Skarsgård's casting, with Yoji Shinkawa returning (translated)
entry.summary: Physint has confirmed Bill Skarsgård as the lead, while Yoji Shinkawa will also return, making the related cast and poster details the focus of this update. The platform shift from PlayStation to Xbox, meanwhile, has players paying attention to both its release scope and their hardware choices.

entry.title: World of Warcraft: Forever Beta Faces Instability as Players Flood In (translated)
entry.summary: After the World of Warcraft: Forever beta opened, the influx of players caused long queues and disconnects, making whether the servers could withstand the surge in interest the first real-world test. The development team is expanding capacity, but for now players still have to wait to get in while availability remains unstable.

entry.title: Australian Players Can Use McDonald's Rewards Points to Play the World of Warcraft: Forever Beta Early (translated)
entry.summary: Australian players can use 1,000 MyMaccas Rewards points to redeem an early-access code for the World of Warcraft: Forever beta through Partner Rewards in the McDonald's app; the beta began on September 17, 2026 AEST and runs until October 22. The redemption deadline is 11:59 p.m. AEST on October 20, and supplies are limited; after obtaining a code, players must also log in to or create a Battle.net account to activate it. Those without enough points can still pre-order the $96.00 Skyborne Epic Pack for guaranteed eligibility, or register for a chance to gain access. This partnership places an early route into the game test inside Australia's food-service rewards system, allowing players to choose among redeeming points, pre-ordering guaranteed eligibility, and registering for a chance to qualify.

entry.title: 《Mobile Legends: Bang Bang》Advanced Server 2.2.20 Update: Hero and Battlefield Adjustments (translated)
entry.summary: The Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Advanced Server has released version 2.2.20, with simultaneous adjustments to heroes, systems, the battlefield, and modes, giving players an early look at the balance direction that may be adopted in the live environment. Lunox and Xavier have been buffed, but the Advanced Server content is still in testing, and the actual release may still change.

entry.title: Seeking Volunteer Game Reviewers (All Genders) en (translated)
entry.summary: USK is recruiting players aged 18 or over who are familiar with different game genres and platforms to serve as volunteer Spielesichter*innen supporting the preparation of statutory age ratings. Those selected must thoroughly review submitted games, document their gameplay, technical features, story, and child- and youth-protection factors, write a test report, then present it to independent child-protection experts and answer their questions. The work requires being able to attend in person in Berlin and values reliability, confidentiality, communication skills, and German and English proficiency; each assignment is coordinated according to the number of cases, the available time, and the individual’s willingness, while the age rating itself is still determined through a formal review process.

entry.title: 10× the Playtime at the Same Price! GeForce NOW’s New Night-Owl Unlimited-Play Deal, the Titanium Dawn Plan—Trial Recommendation (translated)
entry.summary: For players whose only gaming time after work is in the early hours and who do not want to buy high-end hardware for AAA titles, NVIDIA and Taiwan Mobile have launched GeForce NOW’s “Titanium Dawn Plan”: NT$200 per month, usable only from 2:00 a.m. to noon, with the base playtime increased from the original Titanium Plan’s 5 hours to 50 hours. There is also currently a promotional offer for unlimited play during the eligible hours. 4Gamers tested it on an aging GTX 1060 laptop, a MacBook Neo, an iPad Air, and a Steam Deck, and found that as long as the network is stable, cloud RTX hardware can still support high-quality visuals and low-latency gaming. The trade-off is clear: save on hardware costs in exchange for a fixed time window and dependence on the network environment.

entry.title: Baba Is You tabletop game launches crowdfunding: a two-player competitive puzzle game that guides “YOU” to “WIN” by moving text on the board (translated)
entry.summary: The crowdfunding focus of the tabletop version of Baba Is You is not merely turning the video game into a physical product; it brings the original’s puzzle-solving core—“moving words and rewriting rules”—to the tabletop, letting players advance the situation by rearranging rule materials. BitewingGames launched the campaign on Kickstarter on September 15, with pledge options starting at $49; shipping a single box to Japan costs an additional $29. This format preserves the game’s core sense of control, while also asking backers to bear delivery risk as they wait for the finished product, so it is better understood as a choice to support a crowdfunding campaign and wait for the work to be delivered, rather than as an in-stock purchase.

entry.title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms: Hadou launches its sixth-anniversary new season, “Dragon Qi Resonance,” with simultaneous overhauls to siege battles and the new troop class (translated)
entry.summary: The sixth-anniversary update to Romance of the Three Kingdoms: Hadou focuses on an underlying overhaul of siege battles and adds the second new troop class, “Engineer,” in the new season “Dragon Qi Resonance.” The season opens on September 17, and the development team has also explained the direction of the changes and the Engineer’s uses in an interview, so this update affects both battlefield rules and the tactics available to players. For players familiar with the old system, the adjustment of the core mechanics means that judgments built up in the past need to be recalibrated; the additional avenues of action provided by the Engineer will also create new branches in siege choices. Players are therefore dealing with more than an additional usable unit: in the new season, they must understand the rules, decision-making, and attack routes of siege battles anew, which also means updating their existing understanding; if the season’s pace requires players to repeatedly chase progress, whether these new options can remain viable over the long term will also be affected by the live-service cycle.

entry.title: P5X and P3P Collaboration Opening Video Revealed; Kotone Shiomi Arrives on September 24 (translated)
entry.summary: To celebrate the Persona series' 30th anniversary, Kotone Shiomi, the female protagonist of P3P, will officially join P5X in the September 24 update. Rather than reusing her model from the original game, her 3D model has been rebuilt according to P5X's body proportions and art style. The official team has also released a limited-time opening video showing her alongside P5X's protagonist, and the collaboration will include rearranged music from P3P. Her addition was first teased during a special program in Japan in July, while the next round of details is scheduled to be revealed on the official program Persona X-Stream airing on September 21, extending the crossover from an anniversary celebration into a character debut and time-limited content. This arrangement also ties the character's addition, the video's release, and the subsequent livestream into a single timeline.

entry.title: A Parent's Guide to Marvel's Wolverine (translated)
entry.summary: When evaluating Marvel’s Wolverine, parents should first separate the “superhero” premise from the content: the ESRB has rated the PlayStation 5 title M (17+), with rating descriptors covering blood and gore, intense violence, partial nudity, drug references, strong language, and in-game purchases. Combat is presented through claw attacks, stabbings, and slow-motion finishing moves, with dismemberment in some scenes as well; although Insomniac Games provides settings that can reduce the blood, dismemberment, and visible injuries to Wolverine, and can adjust the difficulty, language and drug-related content will not disappear as a result. In other words, what can be adjusted is some of the presentation of violence—not the M-rated content as a whole.

entry.title: Unleash the Hadoken! Apex Legends officially announces limited-time Street Fighter 6 collaboration content, skins, and more (translated)
entry.summary: Apex Legends and Street Fighter 6 are launching a limited-time collaboration. Starting September 22, the Wildcard mode will add fighting-game moves, a themed map, and new unlockable skins, allowing players to temporarily switch to the control language of a fighting game within a familiar combat setting. The gameplay and visual themes of the two titles will therefore meet within the same event experience, with the changes available to players concentrated in the collaboration period.

entry.title: 【TGS 26】First Look at Hello Kitty Party Paradise Gameplay Footage: Play Minigames with Sanrio Characters (translated)
entry.summary: Hello Kitty Party Paradise will launch on October 29, bringing together Sanrio characters and minigames while supporting both generations of Switch. Bahamut previewed gameplay footage at the Tokyo Game Show, with the content focused on character interactions and minigames within the party, placing the game's appeal in how it is arranged for people to play together rather than merely in its character roster.

entry.title: 【ASL】All Protoss Eliminated; the Quarterfinals Set Up a Jaedong vs. “짭제동” Showdown (translated)
entry.summary: After Group D of the ASL Round of 16 concluded, the race distribution for the quarterfinals was set at 0 Protoss, 3 Terran, and 5 Zerg. All Protoss players were eliminated, so the latter stages of the tournament are now filled by matchups between just two races. Lee Young-han finished first in Group D, while Kim Jung-woo took second. Kim Jung-woo defeated his opponent 2–0 in the lower bracket, then won consecutive games in the final match to claim a quarterfinal berth as Group D’s runner-up and complete his advance. The quarterfinal draw produced four matchups, with the headline pairing being reigning champion “짭제동” against Lee Jae-dong; the other matches have also been assigned. The matches are scheduled for September 21, 22, 28, and 29. The bracket both highlights the extreme race distribution and preserves a matchup carrying the “제동록” storyline in the quarterfinals, leaving the next stage’s viewing focus on how the two intersect.

entry.title: inZOI Producer Group Interview: Development Was Difficult, But We Don't Regret It (translated)
entry.summary: After a system rework, several delays, and a decline in player numbers, inZOI is still aiming for a full release next year. Through hands-on time with the latest major update and interviews with the producers, Chuapp lays out the plan to develop the single-player version, the Online version, and community mods in parallel, along with the difficulties that path creates; the report focuses on how product expansion and the pace of development can move forward together.

entry.title: Chuapp Odd Talk: “You Don’t Have Much Time Left” (translated)
entry.summary: After the one-year cycle came to an end, EA Sports FC 26’s UT mode stopped adding new events, and its web version and online app have also closed; players can still access the single-player content, while basic online matches can continue for a while. As most players are expected to move on to the upcoming FC 27, the older title still preserves an entry point for play, but no longer maintains the original activity cadence of its core online content.

entry.title: The AI Digital Human miHoYo Announced It Would Shut Down Was Given “Cyber Immortality” by a Group of Players (translated)
entry.summary: After the service was discontinued, this AI digital human did not disappear from players’ view; instead, she lived on through community records and memories as a form of “cyber immortality.” The report traces how players identified her by starting with an account on Bilibili that had only seven piano-performance videos and clues from Genshin Impact; interviewees asked that their names and exact locations be withheld.

entry.title: God of War: Laufey Faces More Pressure to Prove Itself After Marvel's Wolverine's Chaotic Launch (translated)
entry.summary: Polygon argues that God of War: Laufey originally had relatively safe conditions: Santa Monica Studio is continuing the cinematic action-adventure path that PlayStation has established over the past several generations, and the series has also earned praise from critics and players in the past. But Marvel's Wolverine launched five years after its announcement amid mixed reviews, online culture wars, and the reputational pressure of Sony ending physical disc production in 2028. Those pressures turn God of War: Laufey, scheduled to launch on February 16, 2027, into a crucial test of whether Sony can still make players trust major first-party releases. Since it is also the first God of War game to replace Kratos with a female protagonist, the article expects online attacks and counterattacks to intensify early; the real test is whether players are still willing to invest in Sony's big-budget productions.

entry.title: Atomfall, the Best Fallout Alternative in Years, Is About to Leave Game Pass Forever (translated)
entry.summary: Atomfall’s value does not lie in copying Fallout’s scale, but in placing player choice inside a post-disaster lake district with a distinctly British character: the game reimagines the 1957 Windscale fire, adds science-fiction elements, and replaces vast wastelands with dense open areas and characters players can encounter throughout. Polygon therefore recommends it to Game Pass players, especially those who enjoy a choice-driven experience in the vein of Fallout: New Vegas; it has no levels or experience points and is not as expansive as modern Fallout, but Atomfall is leaving the platform this month, and the window for players to experience it is already counting down.

entry.title: Target will impose unusually strict release rules for the Pokémon 30th-anniversary trading card set (translated)
entry.summary: The Pokémon 30th-anniversary TCG set will launch on Sept. 16, and Target is expected to treat the release as a specially controlled event rather than a normal product drop. Based on reports and photos from Target employees, Polygon says stores will tighten rules for lines, security, and purchase limits; against the backdrop of many U.S. players being accustomed to buying cards at Target, these procedures will directly affect whether collectors can get a set and will extend the competition beyond simply comparing prices to showing up, waiting in line, and following rules on site.

entry.title: A New GTA 6 Image Sparks a Frenzy; Rockstar Stays Silent as Players Guess It Could Be a Promotional Signal (translated)
entry.summary: A new GTA 6 image from Rockstar has sparked a great deal of speculation among players, while images posted by musicians such as Travis Scott have also been brought into the discussion, with players trying to determine whether they are part of the game's promotion. The focus of this discussion is how scattered visual clues can be connected into a possible promotional direction.

entry.title: Game Pass Adds 6 Games from Late September to Early October, 4 of Them Day-One Releases (translated)
entry.summary: Game Pass is set to add six new releases from late September through early October, four of them day-one launches, concentrating the content update into a short period. Gears of War: E-Day, Minecraft Dungeons II, and Dune: Awakening are on the list; Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, meanwhile, is moving to the Premium plan, leaving subscribers to reshuffle which game to play first.

entry.title: The Witcher 3 Remake Must Not Make CD Projekt Red Look Inferior Beside 2026's Big Releases: This Classic RPG Is Not Untouchable (translated)
entry.summary: The Witcher 3 remake has to do more than remake a classic; it also has to prove its value in an environment crowded with new releases in 2026. CD Projekt Red wants the new version to present the game in a modernized form, showing players that it is more than an exercise in nostalgia for the 2015 original; the original's classic status alone cannot spare the remake from comparison.

entry.title: Creators of the Professor Layton game admit to using AI, and players struggle to accept it (translated)
entry.summary: LEVEL-5 originally wanted to use generative AI to respond to long-running delays: founder and president Akihiro Hino hoped to automate the creative process on a large scale, compressing the common five-to-ten-year development cycle into two years, and bring this direction to works such as Professor Layton and Inazuma Eleven. But in the LEVEL5 VISION 2026 II: Dreams showcase broadcast on September 10, the trailer displayed anomalies including blurred backgrounds, distorted faces, and stiff animation; even Hino's AI avatar was placed in a distorted scene, and YouTube quickly accumulated more than 41,000 Dislikes against only 30,600 Likes. The report said the showcase brought the disputes over efficiency, artistic responsibility, and the use of existing works into the open; even after management apologized, it still said future works would continue using AI, so the controversy expanded from a single showcase to LEVEL-5's long-term production direction.

entry.title: Valheim 1.0 Potential Forge: Where to Find It and How to Use It? (translated)
entry.summary: Valheim 1.0 adds the Potential Forge, which is not an upgraded version of an ordinary workbench but a special facility that lets weapons, tools, armor, and shields exceed their normal upgrade limits while also carrying the risk of damage. It appears only in new worlds created in the full version, at a summit in the Mountains biome near its boss, Moder; once you get close, an icon appears on the map. Using it also requires Idols obtained according to the biome and type of metal, divided into combat and protection categories. Every upgrade has a considerable chance of failure: failure brings down lightning, shatters the item, and returns only the base materials, while the upgrade materials invested previously do not come back. The guide therefore presents it as an optional feature, and players must first weigh whether pursuing maximum stats is worth that cost.

entry.title: Sony-owned studio congratulates Insomniac Games on releasing Marvel’s Wolverine (translated)
entry.summary: The early reception to Marvel’s Wolverine first appeared in numbers: a score of 77 on Metacritic, 70% of critics recommended it according to OpenCritic, and a 4.85/5 rating on the PS Store; the development team also spent several days studying the reviews and began making adjustments. On the day of its release, September 15, a Sony-owned studio posted key art on social media to pay tribute to Insomniac Games, so the news placed the publisher’s customary congratulations alongside the context of the game’s early post-launch word of mouth within the same signal.

entry.title: Diablo 30th Anniversary: “Embers of Hell” Season Launches Sept. 16! Battle Diablo, Baal, Mephisto, and Other Series Bosses (translated)
entry.summary: Diablo IV will launch the “Embers of Hell” Season on September 16, turning nostalgic content for the series’ 30th anniversary into a replayable season and permanent activities. At a BlizzCon panel, the development team explained that echoes of Diablo, Baal, and Mephisto will return to Sanctuary alongside familiar faces such as Deckard Cain and Nihlathak; players will also be able to challenge classic locations from the original game through Diablo Immortal, encounter nearly 20 bosses from across the series and more than 25 characters, and obtain nine classic Unique items that will remain permanently. The seasonal quests continue the story of the death cult and the dead’s transformation, while Evil Shards, reborn characters, and an account-wide Conquest plan reshape progression. The Horadric Cube and occult crafting are also being adjusted, allowing existing gear to enter a new progression path; as a result, this is not merely a retrospective, but also connects the series’ memories to the current endgame and future story.

entry.title: 【Interview】The Final Siege Battle Before the Second Server Transfer: Highlights of the 13th Siege Battle (translated)
entry.summary: Before the second server transfer, Inven reviewed the 13th Siege Battle. The focus was not a complete reshuffling, but how each war zone used its final clash to confirm the existing balance of power. In Astaire, the Orc Fortress changed hands several times after the battle began, but the original defenders ultimately held it; Pa'agrio maintained a distribution of two castles for one side and one for the other, with repeated probing by both offense and defense failing to produce a breakthrough. Khrist, however, seized the moment when the opponent's offensive weakened, captured the Orc Fortress, and secured two castles, creating a rare reversal. As a result, this week's outcome sends two signals at once: most factions remain balanced, but Khrist's two-castle reversal has created a new starting point for the distribution of power before the second transfer.

entry.title: 【LCK Finals】LCK champions Gen.G: “This year, we learned to get back on our feet, and we’re confident about Worlds” (translated)
entry.summary: On September 13, 2026, Gen.G defeated Hanwha Life Esports 3–1 at Seoul’s KSPO Dome, winning the LCK championship for a second consecutive year and bringing the organization’s total to seven titles. Ruler was also named Finals MVP. The post-match interviews highlighted more than the result: the coach and players acknowledged mistakes in the Game 1 draft, but stabilized the series through the games that followed; Ruler said that during his slump he had doubted whether he could continue his professional career, and eventually regained his form by adopting a mindset of not holding the team back and continuing to put in extra practice, while Chovy took on the responsibility of steadying the team through his experience. Canyon will carry the momentum into the upcoming Asian Games, and the coach said the team would first adjust its condition before Worlds, then focus on building communication and synergy in the short term. This championship is therefore both a back-to-back title and a source of psychological confidence for Gen.G as it approaches its next international stage.

entry.title: [BZ 26] Diablo 5 Set for Spring 2029, Initial Details Revealed; New Class “Plague Knight” and More to Be Added (translated)
entry.summary: Diablo 5 is expected to launch in spring 2029, still nearly three years away; BlizzCon 2026 first revealed the new class and initial setting, with the story beginning as Diablo conquers Sanctuary and the locals and souls are drawn into the Eternal Conflict. For now, the reveal sketches out what players are waiting for and the direction the world is set to take.

entry.title: 【BZ 26】Blizzard’s Next Chapter Officially Begins! New StarCraft Shooter, Diablo 5, and World of Warcraft: Eternal Revealed, and More (translated)
entry.summary: Returning after a two-year hiatus, BlizzCon 2026 brought the future directions of several Blizzard titles together before players: a new StarCraft shooter, Diablo 5, and World of Warcraft: Eternal appeared, while Heroes of the Storm and Warcraft 3: Reforged also received content updates, turning the event into a look ahead across multiple fronts.

entry.title: [Interview] Why Is Hearthstone's New Class a Monk? (translated)
entry.summary: At BlizzCon 2026, Hearthstone laid out its upcoming content as an update roadmap running from the near term to the long term: The Dark Empire's Ascendancy launches on October 20, set in an ancient Azeroth where the Old Gods and Titans fought, and introduces the “Combination” keyword, which can merge the elements of two cards; Battlegrounds will add the “Mutant” tribe, whose members awaken sleeping Old Gods when they die, and the journal has also been revised to bring stories, quests, achievements, and events together in one place. The team has also scheduled a steady stream of events and gameplay additions over the next nine months, beginning with a 2v2 Tavern Brawl to test co-op play; the new Monk class is expected to be added in March 2027. Executive Producer Nathan Lyons-Smith and Senior Game Design Manager Brendan Sewell said these plans both respond to players’ survey preference for the Monk and aim to give them reasons to keep coming back during gaps between card-set releases.

entry.title: BlizzCon 2026 New Releases Roundup: New StarCraft Game and Diablo V Revealed for the First Time en (translated)
entry.summary: BlizzCon 2026 returned to Anaheim, California, on September 13, three years after the previous event held in 2023, under the theme “The Next Chapter.” This year’s announcements spanned both the near and distant future: Heroes of the Storm will add Xal’atath on September 29, Diablo IV will introduce the Hellfire Season Legacy on September 15, and World of Warcraft: Eternity will enter beta on September 17 before its official release on November 4; the long-term focus includes a new open-world shooter set in the StarCraft universe, planned for release in 2030, and Diablo V, set in a destroyed Sanctuary and arriving in spring 2029. The event also brought a new Hearthstone expansion, the Amazon Warrior for Diablo IV in 2027, and the Warcraft III: Reforged 3.0 update, leaving players to separate their expectations for near-term content from those for games still years away.

entry.title: Ranking the Greatest Video Game Franchises of the 20th Century (translated)
entry.summary: Polygon looks back at twentieth-century video games through a ranking that places the key franchises it considers indispensable on a single historical index. The article does more than list which works matter most; it also tries to explain why they make that period of gaming memory so vivid. For readers, the list can shorten the path to looking back and getting started, becoming an entry point for exploration. At the same time, this compilation reflects Polygon's choices about game history: the franchises included are given a clearer place, while excluded works do not appear in the main line of this narrative.

entry.title: Blizzard and Nintendo Announce New Games One After Another: Diablo V, StarCraft: Dominion, and a New Metroid (translated)
entry.summary: Last week’s gaming-news focus pointed simultaneously to Metroid Ravenous, Diablo V, and StarCraft Dominion. Gry-Online placed the three series side by side as the main highlights, directing players’ anticipation toward Blizzard and Nintendo all at once; this roundup put the three names into the same week’s gaming conversation.
